name: Blush Lotus Bowl
story: Hand-formed on the wheel and finished with a mineral blush wash that bleeds organically across the surface — no two bowls share exactly the same speckle pattern. The lotus petal rim is shaped by hand before the clay stiffens.

name: Blue Daisy Ribbed Trinket Box
story: A ribbed tower with a conical lid, finished in soft ivory. The hand-sculpted daisy appliqué is painted in layers of teal and cerulean, each petal individually detailed. Lift the lid to find a smooth interior — perfect for rings, salts, or small treasures.

name: Yellow Sunflower Wax Cluster
story: Three sunflower forms pressed together in warm goldenrod soy wax, each centre studded with a hand-placed pearl. Burns slowly from the wick at centre. A conversation piece before it becomes a candle.

name: Clay Daisy Wax Disc
story: A large flat daisy moulded in warm terracotta-toned soy wax with a contrasting cream-white centre. Designed to float in a bowl of water or stand as a sculptural piece. Hand-poured in a single casting.

name: Lavender Ribbed Pillar Candle
story: A tapered hexagonal pillar with hand-ribbed sides in dusty lavender. The smaller pink daisy wax decoration at its base is poured separately and nestled against the pillar — together they read like something found in a field at dusk. Burns 40–50 hours.

name: Ivory Ribbed Trinket Box
story: The same ribbed tower form as our daisy box, finished in a bare matte ivory — no appliqué, just the texture of the clay ridges and the softly domed lid. A quieter piece that earns its place by feel.

name: Chocolate Floral Wax Cluster
story: Three five-petal flower forms moulded in rich chocolate-brown soy wax, clustered together at the base. The petals catch light the way a dried botanical would. A warm, earthy presence on any surface.

name: Gold Sunflower Wax Disc
story: A single large sunflower disc poured in deep amber-gold soy wax with a warm brown centre. The petals are pressed into fine detail — each one slightly different, as a real sunflower would be. Burns from a single centre wick.

name: Ivory Pillar with Floral Embeds
story: A ribbed ivory pillar wrapped at its base with hand-applied wax botanicals in warm chocolate tones — each flower separately moulded, pearl-centred, and pressed into place while the wax is still warm. Burns 45–55 hours.

name: Ivory Lotus Tealight Holder
story: The lotus bowl form in its purest expression — unglazed on the outside, smooth matte inside, each petal rim hand-crimped. Place a tealight inside and the light edges glow around the rim. Simple. Tactile. Made to be held.

name: Black & Gold Lotus Tealight Holder
story: The statement piece. A matte black lotus bowl with every petal tip and inner seam finished in hand-applied gold. The contrast is deliberate — the black body recedes so the gold reads like light caught in the clay itself. Gift it as you'd gift a piece of jewellery.

name: Rose Tower Candle
story: Three stacked rose blooms form a tower in warm golden-yellow and blush soy wax, each bloom individually detailed and layered over the next. The colour gradients from deep gold at the top through ivory and pink — hand-poured in sections. Burns 60+ hours.

name: Fishnet Floral Planter
story: A small round planter whose entire outer surface is textured with pressed fishnet — each diamond of the pattern slightly uneven, as the texture was pressed by hand into wet clay. At the front, a cluster of relief florals in pure white. Drainage hole at base.
